name: absensi-mansaba-monorepo
description: Deployment root for Absensi Mansaba (Client + Server)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.compile: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
